spans.s: कक् (I) vt. or vi. 1Ā (pp. कंकित) 1. To wish; 2. to be proud; 3. to be unsteady.
कक् (II) vt. 1Ā (pres. कंकते) To go.
ककुंजल m. The Chātaka bird.

ककुद् f. 1. A peak, a summit; 2. chief, head; 3. the bump on the shoulders of the Indian bull; 4. an ensign or symbol of royalty.(According to grammarians, ककुद् is the form which must be substituted for ककुद at the end of compounds, e.g. त्रिककुद् ‘three-peaked.’)
ककुद्-मत् m. 1. a buffalo with a hump on his shoulders, मदोदग्राः ककुद्मन्तः सरितां कूलमुद्रुजाः R.iv.22, K.S.i.56; 2. a mountain, ककुद्मानिव चित्रकूटः R.xiii.47.
ककुद्-मती f. the hip and loins.
ककुद्-स्थ m. an epithet of पुरंजय, a king of the Solar race, R.vi.71. (See App. II.)
काकुत्स्थ m. A descendant of ककुत्स्थ, an epithet of kings of the Solar dynasty, काकुत्स्थमालोकयतां नृपाणाम् R.vi.2, xii.30, 46.
ककुद m.n. 1. The hump on the shoulders of the Indian bull; 2. head, chief, इक्ष्वाकुवंश्यः ककुदं नृपाणाम् R.vi.71; ककुदं वेदविदाम् Mrich.i.; 3. a peak, a summit; 4. a symbol of royalty, R.iii.70.
काकुद n. The palate.
ककुद्मिन् m. 1. A mountain; 2. a bull with a hump on his shoulders; 3. a name of king रैवत.
ककुद्मिन्-कन्या, -सुता f. Revatī, wife of Balarāma, Sis.ii.20.
ककुद्मिन्-कन्या, -सुता f. Revatī, wife of Balarāma, Sis.ii.20.
ककुंदर n. The cavities of the loins (ककुंदरे जघनकूपकौ Mit. on Yaj.iii.96).
ककुभ् f. 1. A peak, a summit; 2. a quarter of the compass, e.g. विलोकयंती ककुभोऽतिभीता; 3. beauty, grace; 4. a wreath of Champaka flowers; 5. a sacred treatise.
ककुभ (I) m. 1. A crooked piece of wood at the end of the lute; 2. the Arjuna tree.
ककुभ (II) n. A flower of the Kuṭaja tree, Megh.i.22.
कक्कुल m. The Bakula tree.
कक्कोल (I) m. Name of a plant bearing a berry, आकंपितकक्कोलैर्नमेरुकुसुमपांशुपातिभिः Kad.
कक्कोल (II) n. 1. A berry of this plant; 2. a perfume prepared from its berries.

काकोल m. 1. A raven, M.v.14, Yaj.i.174; 2. a snake; 3. name of a hell^1, Yaj.iii.223.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260604. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/249.
कक्कोली f. See कक्कोल I, कक्कोली (v.l. for कंकोली) फलजग्धिमुग्धविकिरव्याहरिणः M.M.vi.
कक्खट a. (f. टा) 1. Hard, solid; 2. laughing.
कक्खट a. (f. टा) 1. Hard, solid; 2. laughing.
कक्खटी f. Chalk.

कक्ष (I) m. 1. A hiding place; 2. the interior of a forest, आशु निर्गत्य कक्षात् Rt.i.27; 3. a dry wood; 4. grass, यतस्तु कक्षस्तत एव वह्निः R.vii.55, M.vii.110; 5. a climbing plant; 6. the side or flank; 7. the armpit, प्रक्षिप्योदर्चिषं कक्षे शेरते तेऽभिमारुतम् Sis.ii.42; 8. a buffalo; 9. a gate; 10. the end of the lower garment, which, after the cloth is carried round the body, is brought up behind and tucked into the waistband; 11. the harem of a king; 12. marshy ground.
कक्ष (II) n. 1. Sin; 2. a star.

कक्षा f. 1. An elephant’s rope; 2. a woman’s girdle; 3. the wrist; 4. a surrounding wall; 5. a courtyard, an enclosure; 6. a room, an apartment, कक्षांतराण्यद्रिपतेर्विवेश K.S.vii.70, गृहकलहंसकाननुसरन् कक्षांतरप्रधावितः Kad., M.vii.224; 7. similarity; 8. the armpit; 9. the end of the lower garment, which, after the cloth is carried round the body, is brought up behind and tucked into the waistband; 10. the waist; 11. tying up the waist; 12. an upper garment; 13. objection or reply in argument; 14. emulation, rivalry.
काक्ष m. A sidelong look, a malicious look, a glance, काक्षेणानादरेक्षितः Bt.v.24.
कक्ष-अवेक्षक m. 1. a superintendent of the harem; 2. a gardener; 3. a door-keeper; 4. a paramour; 5. an actor; 6. a debauchee; 7. eagerness of feeling, strength of sentiment.
कक्ष-धर n. the shoulder joint.
कक्ष-प m. a tortoise.
कक्ष-शाय, -शायु m. a dog.
कक्ष-शाय, -शायु m. a dog.
कक्षा-अंतर n. 1. an inner room, a private apartment; 2. another room.
कक्षा-पट m. a cloth passed between the legs to cover the privities.

कक्ष्या f. (used in most of the senses of कक्षा) 1. The girth of an elephant or horse; 2. a woman’s girdle; 3. similarity; 4. the inner apartment of a palace; 5. an upper garment; 6. the border of a garment; 7. an enclosure.
काक (I) m. 1. A crow, M.vii.31; 2. an impudent fellow; 3. a lame man; 4. washing the head only in bathing.
काक (II) n. A multitude of crows.

काक-अक्षिगोलकन्याय m. the maxim of the crow’s eye. It takes its origin from the belief that crows have but one eye, which, as occasion requires, they move from the cavity on one side into that of the other. And is applied to a word which serves two purposes in a sentence being put only once.
काक-अरि m. an owl.
काक-उदर m. a snake, e.g. काकोदरो येन विनीतदर्पः.
काक-उलूकिका f. the natural enmity of the owl and the crow.
काक-उलूकीय n. the natural enmity of the owl and the crow.
काक-चिंचा f. the gunjā plant.
काक-छद, -छदि m. 1. a wagtail; 2. a side lock of hair.
काक-छद, -छदि m. 1. a wagtail; 2. a side lock of hair.
काक-जात m. the Indian cuckoo.

काक-तालीय n. anything happening unexpectedly and accidentally, an accident, अहो नु खलु भोः तदेतत् काकतालीयं नाम M.M.v.(This word is used adverbially also in the sense of ‘accidentally,’ फलंति काकतालीयं तेभ्यः प्राज्ञा न बिभ्यति Ve.ii.)

काक-तालीय˚न्याय m. the maxim of the crow and the palm. It originates in the unexpected fall of a palm tree at the moment when a crow sat on it and indicates any unexpected and accidental occurrence. See Mall. on Kir.ii.31.
काक-तालुकिन् a. contemptible, vile.
काक-दंत m. the tooth of a crow, i.e. anything impossible or not existing.
काक-दंत˚गवेषण n. searching after an impossibility, any useless and unprofitable task.
काक-ध्वज m. the submarine fire.
काक-निद्रा f. a light slumber.
काक-पक्ष, -पक्षक m. side-locks of hair on the temples of boys and young men, R.iii.28, xi.1, 31, 42.
काक-पक्ष, -पक्षक m. side-locks of hair on the temples of boys and young men, R.iii.28, xi.1, 31, 42.
काक-पद (I) n. the sign (‸) in Mss. marking that something has been left-out.
काक-पद (II) m. a mode of sexual enjoyment.
काक-पुच्छ, -पुष्ट m. the Indian cuckoo.
काक-पुच्छ, -पुष्ट m. the Indian cuckoo.
काक-पेय a. shallow, काकपेया नदी S.K.
काक-भीरु m. an owl.
काक-मद्गु m. a gallinule.
काक-यव m. barren corn, the ear of which has no grain, तथैव पांडवाः सर्वे यथा काकयवा इव Bh., where Nīlakaṇṭha explains काकयव by निष्फलतृणधान्य.
काक-रुत n. the shrill sound of a crow. It is considered as indicative of future good or evil under different circumstances.
काक-वंध्या f. a woman who bears only one child.
काक-स्वर m. a shrill tone.
काकरु(रू)क (I) a. (f. का) 1. Timid, cowardly; 2. naked; 3. poor, indigent.
काकरु(रू)क (II) m. 1. A hen-pecked husband; 2. (fem. ˚ की) an owl; 3. fraud, deceit.
काकरु(रू)क (I) a. (f. का) 1. Timid, cowardly; 2. naked; 3. poor, indigent.
काकरु(रू)क (II) m. 1. A hen-pecked husband; 2. (fem. ˚ की) an owl; 3. fraud, deceit.
काकरु(रू)क (I) a. (f. का) 1. Timid, cowardly; 2. naked; 3. poor, indigent.
काक(का)ल m. A raven.
काक(का)ल m. A raven.

काकलि(ली) f. 1. A low and sweet tone, मधुरकलकंठानां आकलीकलकलेन D.K., Rt.i.8; 2. a musical instrument with a low tone played by theives to ascertain whether a person is asleep or not, फणिमुखकाकलीसंदशक … प्रभृत्यनेकोपकरणयुक्तः D.K.; 3. the gunjā plant.

काकलि(ली) f. 1. A low and sweet tone, मधुरकलकंठानां आकलीकलकलेन D.K., Rt.i.8; 2. a musical instrument with a low tone played by theives to ascertain whether a person is asleep or not, फणिमुखकाकलीसंदशक … प्रभृत्यनेकोपकरणयुक्तः D.K.; 3. the gunjā plant.
काकलि(ली)-रव m. the Indian cuckoo.
काकलि(ली)-रव m. the Indian cuckoo.
काकिणिका f. 1. A sum of money equal to 20 cowries or to a quarter of a paṇa; 2. a weight equal to a quarter of a māsha; 3. a part of a measure; 4. the beam of a balance.
काकिणिका f. 1. A sum of money equal to 20 cowries or to a quarter of a paṇa; 2. a weight equal to a quarter of a māsha; 3. a part of a measure; 4. the beam of a balance.
काकिनी f. 1. A quarter of a paṇa q.v.; 2. a quarter of a measure; 3. a cowri.
काकी f. A female crow.

काकु f. 1. Change of the voice in emotions, such as fear, anger, (भिन्नकंठध्वनिधीरैः काकुरित्यभिधीयते), वक्तृबोद्धव्यकाकूनां … वैशिष्ट्यात् K.Pr.iii.; 2. a word of negation so used as to imply the contrary, as in questions of appeal (the meaning is suggested by a modulation of the voice); 3. muttering, murmuring.
